title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Budget and Financial Accountability - Jamaica

description.narrative: The goal of this project is to strengthen the management of public finances to help ensure the availability of sufficient funds to meet government service delivery needs by improving cash management, internal controls, and the efficiency of the AGD. Project components include: 1) enhancing the oversight and management of cash resources; 2) improving and automating pension benefit calculations and payments; 3) enhancing the effectiveness of the Government Financial Management System to support automated reconciliation of the Central Processing Account (CPA); 4) implementing a travel card payment program to improve controls on government travel expenditures; and 5) enhancing the ability of the AGD reporting unit to provide timely and accurate financial information to management; and 6) improving transparency and accountability by implementing Cash Basis International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) within the central government.
